UPDATE scheduleExecutionHistory 
SET status = 'failed', 
    completedAt = NOW(), 
    durationMs = TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, startedAt, NOW()) / 1000,
    errorMessage = '排程執行超時（已修復：改用 executePersistentSnkrdunkBatchUpdate）'
WHERE scheduleType = 'snkrdunk_update' 
  AND status = 'running' 
  AND completedAt IS NULL;
